items.title: Free Vesica Lattice Mesh DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Screens
items.description: A dense, all-over lattice of overlapping lens shapes and small diamond accents forms a rippling, fabric-like mesh across the entire panel. With no central medallion or border, this design reads as pure repeating texture, well suited as a background or infill pattern rather than a focal artwork.

items.title: Six-Petal Flower Lattice DXF Pattern for Garden Screens
items.description: Six-petal flowers with diamond centers tile edge to edge across the full panel, creating an evenly balanced floral grid. The simple, repeating petal shape keeps the design easy to scale up or down for different panel sizes.
